evidence.reason: The supplied deploy_plan still calls drain_check at line 1212 before load_overlay/helper_precheck and before helper_module.switch at line 1222, with no unit-inactivity check preceding the drain. An already-running tick service can therefore launch a detached review after the drain and exit before switch's inactive/tick_lock checks, allowing the checkout to change under a live review that the drain never saw. The finding identifies an ordinary ordering bug; the proposed pre-drain inactive check addresses the visible race in deploy_plan.
